extension.description: Use the ADR Guard CLI safely from a trusted VS Code workspace.
view.adrExplorer.welcome:
Open a local workspace folder to browse ADRs.
[Refresh](command:adrGuard.refreshExplorer)
configuration.title: ADR Guard
configuration.cli.path: Absolute path to the trusted ADR Guard executable. When empty, the workspace extension host PATH is searched.
configuration.cli.timeoutMilliseconds: Maximum time in milliseconds for an ADR Guard CLI invocation.
configuration.cli.maxOutputBytes: Maximum bytes captured separately from stdout and stderr for an ADR Guard CLI invocation.
configuration.validation.directory: Workspace-relative ADR directory used by validation and ADR creation.
configuration.validation.adrFormat: ADR document format used by validation, index generation, and Explorer metadata: canonical or MADR 4.0.
configuration.validation.baseline: Workspace-relative path to the existing diagnostic baseline JSON file used by baseline validation.
configuration.validation.onSave: Validate ADRs after saving a Markdown file in the configured ADR directory. Disabled by default.
configuration.validation.debounceMillise: Delay in milliseconds used to coalesce validation after saves.
